Source: parent proof Part 5 (Simon Ch. 5, Lemma 2.6 and Corollary 2.7 with the corrections recorded there: Simon's Hⁿ-estimate on B_{σ₀/2} becomes B_{σ₀/4}, Corollary 2.7 holds on B_{σ₀/8}, sup|f| carries the factor σ₀, the second case of (c) is added, and B_{3s}(η) replaces B_s(η) in (9)–(11)). Conventions: E := ℝ^{n+k}; B_t(y) closed ball; Bⁿ_t(v) closed ball in ℝⁿ; M := R.carrier, μ := R.measure; Hⁿ := μHE[n]; ω_n := unitBallVolume n ∈ (0, ∞); p_x := projection onto approxTangentPlane n M x, p_x^⊥ := I − p_x; P := p_{T₀}, Q := I − P; |A|² is the Hilbert–Schmidt norm (the Lean sum), ‖A‖ ≤ |A|; α := 1/(2n+2); write E_{T₀}(y, t) := t^{−n}∫_{B_t(y)}|p_x − P|²dμ. Siblings used: monotonicity ((M2)), density_bounds ((a), (b)), affine_approximation, tangent_projection_measurable.

0. Constants. Let C₆ ≥ 1 be given. Take δ₁ from density_bounds and δ₃, C₃ from affine_approximation, and put δ₅ := min{δ₁, δ₃} ∈ (0, 1/8]. Put C₈ := max{C₃ + (8C₃/ω_n + 2^{n+3}/ω_n)^{1/2}, 4C₆} and C₉ := 144·3ⁿ/ω_n. Choose β ∈ (0, 1/4] so small that C₈β ≤ ½, 2√k C₈β ≤ 1, and 2·3ⁿ·72k C₈²β²·2·5ⁿ ≤ ¼ (conditions involving k are vacuous if k = 0), and put β' := min{β, (2·5ⁿC₉)^{−1/2}} (so C₉5ⁿβ'² < 1), C_b := 2ω_n(5/2)ⁿ and C₇ := max{√k C₆, (C_b + 2^{n/2}ω_n15ⁿC₉(C_b + 1))β^{−2}}. All depend only on n, k, C₆.
1. Setting. Let 0 < δ ≤ δ₅ and the hypotheses hold; r₁ := δρ; ξ ∈ spt μ ∩ B_{r₁}(z); 0 < σ₀ ≤ r₁; T₀ an n-plane; 0 < L ≤ 1 with δ^α ≤ βL; (i) ∫_{B_{σ₀}(ξ)}|p_x − P|²dμ ≤ C₆δ^{2α}σ₀ⁿ; (ii) |Q(x − ξ)| = dist(x − ξ, T₀) ≤ C₆δ^ασ₀ for x ∈ spt μ ∩ B_{σ₀}(ξ). (Hypothesis (i) is part of the parent's setting but is not needed below: 5A is stated in terms of ∫_{B_{σ₀}(ξ)}|p_x − P|² itself.) Points used below are y ∈ B_{3σ₀/4}(ξ) ⊆ B_{2r₁}(z) and η ∈ B_{σ₀/4}(ξ); all radii are ≤ 5σ₀/4 ≤ (1 − 4δ)ρ; balls B_t(y) with |y − z| ≤ 2r₁ and t ≤ 5σ₀/4 lie in B_ρ(z) ⊆ W. So density_bounds (a), (b) and affine_approximation apply at these points and radii. κ ≥ 0 and κρ ≤ δ ≤ 1/8.
2. Coordinates. Choose orthonormal bases a₁,…,aₙ of T₀ and b₁,…,b_k of T₀^⊥ (dim T₀^⊥ = k) and let ι(v) := Σ vᵢaᵢ, ι'(w) := Σ w_jb_j. These are linear isometries, ι(v) ∈ T₀, ⟨ιv, ι'w⟩ = 0, P x = ι(ι*x), Q x = ι'(ι'*x) (ι*, ι'* adjoints). For g : ℝⁿ → ℝᵏ write Φ_g(v) := ξ + ιv + ι'g(v).
3. (a) The good set. G := {y ∈ spt μ ∩ B_{3σ₀/4}(ξ) : t^{−n}∫_{B_{t/2}(y)}|p_x − P|²dμ ≤ β²L² for all t ∈ (0, σ₀/2]}.
4. (b) μ(B_{3σ₀/4}(ξ) ∖ G) ≤ C_bβ^{−2}L^{−2}∫_{B_{σ₀}(ξ)}|p_x − P|²dμ. For y ∈ (spt μ ∩ B_{3σ₀/4}(ξ)) ∖ G choose t_y ∈ (0, σ₀/2] with β²L²t_yⁿ < ∫_{B_{t_y/2}(y)}|p_x − P|²dμ. By the 5-times covering lemma (Simon Ch. 1, 3.4; Mathlib Vitali.exists_disjoint_subfamily_covering_enlargement_closedBall) there are pairwise disjoint balls B_{t_j/2}(y_j) of this family (countably many, since disjoint balls with nonempty interior in E are countable) with (spt μ ∩ B_{3σ₀/4}(ξ)) ∖ G ⊆ ∪_j B_{5t_j/2}(y_j). The disjoint balls lie in B_{σ₀}(ξ), and μ(B_{5t_j/2}(y_j)) ≤ 2ω_n(5t_j/2)ⁿ by density_bounds (a). Using μ(E ∖ spt μ) = 0: μ(B_{3σ₀/4}(ξ) ∖ G) ≤ Σ_j μ(B_{5t_j/2}(y_j)) ≤ C_bΣ_j t_jⁿ ≤ C_bβ^{−2}L^{−2}Σ_j∫_{B_{t_j/2}(y_j)}|p_x − P|² ≤ C_bβ^{−2}L^{−2}∫_{B_{σ₀}(ξ)}|p_x − P|²dμ.
5. (c) For y₁, y₂ ∈ G: |Q(y₂ − y₁)| ≤ C₈βL|y₂ − y₁|. Let t := |y₁ − y₂| (t ≤ 3σ₀/2; assume t > 0). Case t ≤ σ₀/2: affine_approximation at (y₁, t) (y₁ ∈ spt μ ∩ B_{2r₁}(z), t ≤ 2r₁) gives an n-plane S₁ with dist(y₂ − y₁, S₁) ≤ C₃δ^αt (y₂ ∈ spt μ ∩ B_t(y₁)) and ∫_{B_{t/2}(y₁)}|p_x − p_{S₁}|² ≤ C₃δ^{2α}(t/2)ⁿ; y₁ ∈ G gives ∫_{B_{t/2}(y₁)}|p_x − P|² ≤ β²L²tⁿ. Since |p_{S₁} − P|² ≤ 2|p_x − p_{S₁}|² + 2|p_x − P|² and μ(B_{t/2}(y₁)) ≥ ½ω_n(t/2)ⁿ (density_bounds (b)), |p_{S₁} − P|² ≤ (4/ω_n)(C₃δ^{2α} + 2ⁿβ²L²) ≤ (8C₃/ω_n + 2^{n+3}/ω_n)β²L² (δ^α ≤ βL, C₃ ≥ 1), so |Q(y₂ − y₁)| ≤ dist(y₂ − y₁, S₁) + ‖p_{S₁} − P‖t ≤ C₃βLt + (8C₃/ω_n + 2^{n+3}/ω_n)^{1/2}βLt ≤ C₈βLt. Case t > σ₀/2 (Correction: Simon treats only the first case): by (ii), |Q(y₂ − y₁)| ≤ |Q(y₂ − ξ)| + |Q(y₁ − ξ)| ≤ 2C₆δ^ασ₀ < 4C₆δ^αt ≤ 4C₆βLt ≤ C₈βLt. Since C₈β ≤ ½: |Q(y₂ − y₁)| ≤ ½(|P(y₂ − y₁)| + |Q(y₂ − y₁)|), so |Q(y₂ − y₁)| ≤ |P(y₂ − y₁)| and |Q(y₂ − y₁)| ≤ 2C₈βL|P(y₂ − y₁)|. In particular P is injective on G.
6. (d) Lipschitz extension. On D := {ι*(y − ξ) : y ∈ G} ⊆ ℝⁿ define g₀(ι*(y − ξ)) := ι'*(y − ξ) ∈ ℝᵏ (well defined by 5); by 5, |g₀(v₁) − g₀(v₂)| ≤ 2C₈βL|v₁ − v₂|. Extend each coordinate g₀ʲ to ℝⁿ with the same Lipschitz constant (McShane; Simon Ch. 2, 1.2; Mathlib LipschitzOnWith.extend_real) and truncate it to [−C₆δ^ασ₀, C₆δ^ασ₀]; by (ii) (|g₀ʲ| ≤ |Q(y − ξ)| ≤ C₆δ^ασ₀ on D, as G ⊆ spt μ ∩ B_{σ₀}(ξ)) truncation does not change it on D. The result f : ℝⁿ → ℝᵏ satisfies f = g₀ on D, Lip f ≤ 2√k C₈βL ≤ L (so |f(v) − f(w)| ≤ L|v − w|), |f| ≤ √k C₆δ^ασ₀ ≤ C₇δ^ασ₀, and G ⊆ F := Φ_f(ℝⁿ) (y = ξ + ι(ι*(y − ξ)) + ι'(ι'*(y − ξ)) = Φ_f(ι*(y − ξ))).
7. (e) μ(B_{σ₀/2}(ξ) ∖ F) ≤ μ(B_{3σ₀/4}(ξ) ∖ G) ≤ C_bβ^{−2}L^{−2}∫_{B_{σ₀}(ξ)}|p_x − P|²dμ (G ⊆ F, Step 4).
8. (f) The estimate (10'). Let η ∈ (F ∖ spt μ) ∩ B_{σ₀/4}(ξ). As spt μ is closed, η ∉ spt μ and ξ ∈ spt μ, d := dist(η, spt μ) ∈ (0, |η − ξ|] and is attained at some y ∈ spt μ with |y − η| = d; put s := d/2 ≤ σ₀/8. Then B̆_{2s}(η) ∩ spt μ = ∅, so μ(B_s(η)) = 0, and |y − ξ| ≤ 2|η − ξ| ≤ σ₀/2. By density_bounds (a), (b) at y: ½ω_nsⁿ ≤ μ(B_s(y)) ≤ μ(B_{3s}(η)) ≤ μ(B_{5s}(y)) ≤ 2·5ⁿω_nsⁿ (B_s(y) ⊆ B_{3s}(η) ⊆ B_{5s}(y)). By the sibling (M2) at η with radii s < 3s (B_{3s}(η) ⊆ W) and μ(B_s(η)) = 0: e^{−3κs}(3s)^{−n}μ(B_{3s}(η)) ≤ ∫_{B_{3s}(η)∖B_s(η)}|p_x^⊥(x − η)|²|x − η|^{−n−2}dμ ≤ s^{−n−2}∫_{B_{3s}(η)}|p_x^⊥(x − η)|²dμ, so (3κs ≤ κρ ≤ δ, e^δ ≤ 2) μ(B_{3s}(η)) ≤ 2·3ⁿs^{−2}∫_{B_{3s}(η)}|p_x^⊥(x − η)|²dμ. Now p_x^⊥ − Q = P − p_x, so |p_x^⊥(x − η)|² ≤ 2|Q(x − η)|² + 2|p_x − P|²·9s² for x ∈ B_{3s}(η). For x ∈ F ∩ B_{3s}(η), x = Φ_f(v), η = Φ_f(v_η), and |Q(x − η)| = |f(v) − f(v_η)| ≤ 2√k C₈β|v − v_η| ≤ 2√k C₈β·3s; for x ∉ F, |Q(x − η)| ≤ 3s. Hence ½ω_nsⁿ ≤ μ(B_{3s}(η)) ≤ 2·3ⁿ[72kC₈²β²μ(B_{3s}(η)) + 18μ(B_{3s}(η) ∖ F) + 18∫_{B_{3s}(η)}|p_x − P|²dμ], and by the choice of β, 2·3ⁿ·72kC₈²β²μ(B_{3s}(η)) ≤ 2·3ⁿ·72kC₈²β²·2·5ⁿω_nsⁿ ≤ ¼ω_nsⁿ. Therefore (10'): sⁿ ≤ C₉[μ(B_{3s}(η) ∖ F) + ∫_{B_{3s}(η)}|p_x − P|²dμ]. (Correction: Simon's (9)–(11) write B_σ(η) for B_{3σ}(η); with bounded H no additive error Cδσⁿ occurs.)
9. Hⁿ-estimate. The closed balls B_{3s_η}(η), η ∈ (F ∖ spt μ) ∩ B_{σ₀/4}(ξ), have radii ≤ 3σ₀/8; by the 5-times covering lemma choose pairwise disjoint (countably many) B_{3s_j}(η_j) with (F ∖ spt μ) ∩ B_{σ₀/4}(ξ) ⊆ ∪_j B_{15s_j}(η_j). Since |v − v'| ≤ |Φ_f(v) − Φ_f(v')| and Φ_f is √2-Lipschitz (Lip f ≤ 1), F ∩ B_{15s_j}(η_j) ⊆ Φ_f(Bⁿ_{15s_j}(v_{η_j})) and Hⁿ(F ∩ B_{15s_j}(η_j)) ≤ 2^{n/2}ω_n(15s_j)ⁿ (Mathlib LipschitzOnWith.hausdorffMeasure_image_le; Hⁿ = Lⁿ on ℝⁿ). The disjoint balls B_{3s_j}(η_j) lie in B_{5σ₀/8}(ξ) ⊆ B_{3σ₀/4}(ξ). By (10'), Step 4, G ⊆ F, β ≤ 1 and L ≤ 1: Hⁿ((F ∖ spt μ) ∩ B_{σ₀/4}(ξ)) ≤ 2^{n/2}ω_n15ⁿΣ_js_jⁿ ≤ 2^{n/2}ω_n15ⁿC₉[μ(B_{3σ₀/4}(ξ) ∖ G) + ∫_{B_{σ₀}(ξ)}|p_x − P|²] ≤ 2^{n/2}ω_n15ⁿC₉(C_b + 1)β^{−2}L^{−2}∫_{B_{σ₀}(ξ)}|p_x − P|²dμ.
10. Conclusion 5A. Adding 7 and 9: μ(B_{σ₀/2}(ξ) ∖ F) + Hⁿ((F ∖ spt μ) ∩ B_{σ₀/4}(ξ)) ≤ C₇L^{−2}∫_{B_{σ₀}(ξ)}|p_x − P|²dμ. With 2 and 6, (ι, ι', f) has all properties asserted before the final implication (F = range of v ↦ ξ + ιv + ι'(f v)).
11. (g) Conclusion 5B. Assume moreover ∫_{B_t(y)}|p_x − P|²dμ ≤ β'²L²tⁿ for all y ∈ spt μ ∩ B_{σ₀/2}(ξ), t ∈ (0, σ₀/2]. For such y and t, t^{−n}∫_{B_{t/2}(y)}|p_x − P|² ≤ t^{−n}∫_{B_t(y)}|p_x − P|² ≤ β'²L² ≤ β²L², so y ∈ G ⊆ F; thus spt μ ∩ B_{σ₀/2}(ξ) ⊆ F. Suppose η ∈ (F ∖ spt μ) ∩ B_{σ₀/8}(ξ) and let s, y be as in 8. Then s ≤ |η − ξ|/2 ≤ σ₀/16, B_{3s}(η) ⊆ B_{σ₀/2}(ξ), so μ(B_{3s}(η) ∖ F) ≤ μ((spt μ ∩ B_{σ₀/2}(ξ)) ∖ F) = 0; also y ∈ spt μ ∩ B_{σ₀/4}(ξ), B_{3s}(η) ⊆ B_{5s}(y) and 5s ≤ σ₀/2, so ∫_{B_{3s}(η)}|p_x − P|² ≤ β'²L²(5s)ⁿ. Then (10') gives sⁿ ≤ C₉5ⁿβ'²sⁿ < sⁿ, impossible. Hence F ∩ B_{σ₀/8}(ξ) ⊆ spt μ, and spt μ ∩ B_{σ₀/8}(ξ) = F ∩ B_{σ₀/8}(ξ). ∎
key_steps: Choose orthonormal coordinates ι, ι' for T₀ and T₀^⊥.
Define the good set G; the 5-times covering lemma gives μ(B_{3σ₀/4}(ξ) ∖ G) ≤ C_bβ^{−2}L^{−2}∫_{B_{σ₀}}|p_x − p_{T₀}|².
Prove the cone condition |Q(y₂ − y₁)| ≤ 2C₈βL|P(y₂ − y₁)| on G, via affine_approximation, with a second case for distant points.
Extend by McShane and truncate to get f with Lip f ≤ L, |f| ≤ C₇δ^ασ₀, and G ⊆ F.
Estimate (10') at points of F off the support, via (M2) at η and the density bounds.
Covering argument gives the Hⁿ((F ∖ spt μ) ∩ B_{σ₀/4}) bound, hence 5A.
5B: under the extra hypothesis, spt μ ∩ B_{σ₀/2} ⊆ G ⊆ F, and (10') excludes F ∖ spt μ on B_{σ₀/8}.
